_meta.description: Compose batch of two crosstab slots (control and variant arms of a consumer survey cohort) over region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_T_CELL matrix overlay that runs a per-cell Welch t-test on the means against the matching control cell. Cell aggregator is AGG_WELFORD which emits the streaming Welford-Pebay triple {Mean, Variance, N} as the cell payload (RichAggregator interface). The OVERLAY_T_CELL handler is triple-aware (E1-S9 / S10): when both target and reference cells carry a WelfordTriple the handler consumes the triple directly so variance and n are read from the streaming sample state instead of the Params defaults. Each cell's value becomes the two-sided Welch p-value as a float64. Reuses the studentTTwoSidedP helper backing TEST_T / TEST_WELCH plus the same Welch-Satterthwaite df recurrence, so the overlay p-value matches the row-test surface byte-for-byte for the same (mean, variance, n) inputs (E1-S12 byte-equal parity gate). Math: se = sqrt(var_target/n_target + var_ref/n_ref); t = (mean_target - mean_ref) / se; df = (var_target/n_target + var_ref/n_ref)^2 / ((var_target/n_target)^2/(n_target-1) + (var_ref/n_ref)^2/(n_ref-1)); p = studentTTwoSidedP(t, df). Degenerate inputs (n < 2, variance = 0, missing reference cell) produce NaN p-values with one PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO warning per affected cell. Inherently buffered - inferential overlays as a family stay buffered until a streamable-test path is plumbed (PRD Non-Goals).
_meta.name: pairwise-welch-matrix
